notes.title: Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy 1.0 out now!
notes.notes:
[h2][b][i]Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy is out of Early Access!!![/i][/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1955830/

This won't be Hero of Ice Fairy's last update, but it is the most important one. Cirno, the Hero of Ice's adventure is now complete from start to finish! A big thank you to everyone who played the Early Access versions!!

If you like our game, please help spread the word! It'll be a massive help to us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/190e883efb6cbf032b3ce9939f0b78e16ca9ad6a.png[/img]

Below are some questions we've gathered regarding the full release and updates going forward, and our answers:

Q: Do I have to buy the game again once the game is fully released?
A: Nope, if you've already purchased the game, you'll receive the new content for free on Steam.

Q: Will the game become more expensive after the full release? If it will, by how much?
A: Yes, once the game fully releases, the price will change to 6.99 USD.
(Compared to earlier versions, the full release will only cost 1 USD more as we don't want players to not be able to enjoy our game due to the price. We hope you will continue to support us! )

Q: After the full release, will there be DLC with more playable content?
A: Yup.

Q: Aside from DLC, will the game still have free updates?
A: Yes, we'll still be pushing out free updates in the future.

Q: What will the new free updates and DLC contain?
A: The free updates will contain a new gamemode and new items. The DLC will contain at least one new boss battle with new story and items to go with it.
(More details will be announced in the future! Keep your eyes peeled!)

Q: After the full release, will there still be updates to the New Supporter Pack?
A: Yes, as long as you've purchased the New Supporter Pack, you'll receive a free update once the game fully releases.
(The New Supporter Pack contains the game's OST, sketches and character artworks.)

Q: Will the New Supporter Pack's price change with the full release too?
A: No, the Supporter Pack will forever cost 1.99 USD.

Q: Will the game be on major platforms such as the Nintendo Switch?
A: We're doing our best to make it happen. Stay tuned.

notes.title: Major Content Update Available！
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/ad5b064506929af35c99b9ce8a5d65fdc340d75d.png[/img]

This major update is free for everyone! All players who already own the base game (not prologue) will receive all content in this update free of charge!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1955830/

This major update contains the following new content:

[h2][b]New Stages[/b][/h2]
[i][b]The adventure continues![/b][/i]  Following in the Hero of Ice's footsteps, we've created [b]3[/b] brand new stages with distinct styles, in which you will take on powerful new bosses! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/179aed56cce10a555433ff2ccbcae78518a0fba8.png[/img]
Included in this update is also a [b]special stage[/b]with gameplay unlike any of the stages before.

[h2][b]New Battles[/b][/h2]
[i][b]Every journey has its obstacles![/b][/i]  The Hero of Ice will encounter [b]2[/b] new bosses. They pack a punch, and they're both popular Touhou characters. Players will need to grasp even more combat techniques to stand a chance at defeating them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/15f6b58710732e3cccc4ee80290cb2b38952b11a.png[/img]
Furthermore, the player will have to go up against the game's first ever [b]giant boss[/b].

[h2][b]New Items[/b][/h2]
[i][b]Prepare for battle![/b][/i]  The Hero of Ice will obtain [b]2[/b] new spell cards and [b]6[/b] new items. With these new tools in your arsenal, you'll be able to better take on the new challenges!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/c92cfeb6f357ee851e2d6b01a1e9fd6aea778ad1.png[/img]

[h2][b]And More...!!![/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] A new area in the Bunny Train  the [b]Bunny Lounge[/b]  is now available.
[*] The much-awaited feature of [b]rebinding controller buttons[/b] is now live. You can now rebind controller buttons.
[*] [b]Minigames[/b] separate from the main story are now in development with a release planned for November.

notes.title: 18,000 Copies sold! English Version Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Since its release in February 25, our game—Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy—has managed to break 18k sales in just one month !

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1955830/

This comes as a big shock to us since it wildly surpassed our original expectations. Back in early 2021, I decided to make a no micro-dodging game out of spite since I was suffering from Touhou Hidden Star in Four Seasons's unique problem of not being able to properly see the bullets. I honestly never thought our game'd achieve such results two years down the line. It's thanks to everyone's continued support that we could get to this point. 

Without everyone, we—and by extension Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy—wouldn't be where we are today, and for that we couldn't thank you enough!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323069/a96454a6e7f013b44c134a45c6286aba8406918e.png[/img]

[h1]English Version Coming Soon[/h1]
Currently, we're dedicating our time to finishing the game's English version, with a release slated for April 12. If you're interested in helping us test the English version, please join our Discord server. The first round of testing will commence on the first week of April.

[url=https://discord.gg/nMJXRDjhCc]→Click here to join our Discord server←[/url]

Furthermore, in April we'll also be releasing a feature to replay past story events as well as a mode for players who aren't great at action games, in addition to some new items and spell cards.

We understand that there are high expectations for what comes next in the game, and we promise we'll do our best to give everyone the full Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323069/8bdf20abf5ee9fd445a43d5135a0654ced1cb7cc.png[/img]

notes.title: Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy steam store page out now
notes.notes:
*Prologue and “Touhou hero of ice fairy” are two independent games. *

[h2]Hey guys[/h2]
After a long wait, we are glad to tell you that the steam store page of our game “Touhou hero of ice fairy” is finally open~
If you are interested in our game please add our game to the wish list, which is very important for us. In the future, when the game is officially released, you can also receive the notice for the first time~

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1955830/]Click to enter the steam store of "Touhou hero of ice fairy"[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323069/fb183aa47a1426c0dea23125a7abd5257b928055.png[/img]

The story of the game follows the prologue. After learning that the "Misty lake Princess" Daiyosei was captured by the evil "nightmare Miko" Hakurei Reimu, our most powerful ice hero "Cirno" embarked on her journey to liberate the Gansokyo and save her dear princess.

In addition, there will be a larger number of Touhou characters in the game. No matter whether their position is enemy or friend, Cirno will experience this humorous Princess rescue journey with them (the exquisite drawing of each character is absolutely indispensable)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323069/ce9e4f1e14446225b2fd665266c11f2461986c82.png[/img]

In the game, players will have a lot of interesting "spell cards" and new "items" mechanisms. The funny wacky effects of these spell cards and items can greatly enrich the player's combat experience, and players can use them to create their unique build  (I hope you guys can use different builds to beat the boss in the future)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323069/a5ff0f53ceb18c6782b74292bb4cf48818332faf.png[/img]

We expect to release early access containing "chapters 1 and 2" in October, and the left chapters and the "brave mode" with mild roguelike elements will be gradually updated shortly ~

Finally, there will be bigger news to be released to you in the coming week. Please look forward to it~

* Although the pictures of this article are in Chinese, the English version and Japanese version are also under development. Please wait for us. *

notes.title: Recent Developments #1
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Hello[/b][/h3]
The bitter winter has gone away from us, and the spring day has finally arrived. 
two months has passed in a flash since the update of the "[b]Spring Festival Special Chapter[/b]"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323069/f9a6de42e0b35602780200c8b48c9f4d0c0ed455.png[/img]

It's time to tell you guys the recent development of the "[b]Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy[/b]" full version :
[olist]
[*] The script has been almost completed, and the performance arrangement of every stages are currently in process.
[*] The system framework of the game is about to be completed, and the new mechanism "items" can greatly enrich the battle experience of the full version.
[*] The design of all new characters has also been completed. The boss battle in the full version will be more wonderful and interesting than the prologue.

notes.title: 《东方冰之勇者记：序章》圣诞总结
notes.notes:
大家好呀，
自《东方冰之勇者记：序章》发布以来已经过去了一周的时间，游戏在这一周内获得了大量的评论，甚至还登上了Steam的热门新品榜，获得了远超我们预期的人气，真的非常感谢各位的大力支持~！！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323069/64de93ec41d677c515ef26f6b357646d0e83d8cd.png[/img]

“想做一款属于我们自己的游戏”，就是这样一个简单的念头将我们凝聚了起来，组成了现在的团队，而我们开发的第一款游戏能够如此受大家的欢迎，这对于我们而言真的意义非凡！

同时，我们在激动之余也开始思考应当如何回应大家对正篇游戏的期待。我们作为新晋的游戏开发团队，游戏作品能够获得这么高的人气不仅是对我们的肯定与鼓励，同时也是一场试炼。

最终，我们决定在保持当前开发方向不变的基础上，进一步加强游戏的整体效果，确保正篇《东方冰之勇者记 ~ Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy》的品质足够扎实，为大家带来比序章更为精彩刺激的游戏体验！

[url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1DT4y1f7Z6]BiliBili的视频链接[/url]

此外，我们在BiliBili上传了新的一期视频，其中包含了『本次序章的总结』与『未来正篇的展望』，视频中还出现了正篇游戏中即将出场的新东方角色的『设定草图』，大家记得来看看噢～

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323069/e8da404105dade97d9e8e382fc1b937e95d27f36.jpg[/img]

最后，祝大家圣诞快乐 ~

notes.title: 《东方冰之勇者记：序章》现已正式发布！
notes.notes:
东方同人游戏《东方冰之勇者记：序章》现已正式发布了！

开发历时半年多，这款游戏终于能够面向大家了，此时我们的心情真的非常激动！

半年多前，策划在《东方天空璋》中因为手残 + 天空璋特有的看不清子弹的问题疯狂受苦，一气之下决定制作一款不强调微操躲避子弹的弹幕游戏，拉上社团小伙伴们共同开发了一个用以验证 “高机动弹幕对战” 玩法的测试白盒。当时谁也没想到，这个起因很奇葩的白盒，在经历了半年多以来的反复迭代过后，能够蜕变为现在的《东方冰之勇者记：序章》。

这款序章游戏既是琪露诺那艰辛冒险的开始，也是我们社团在东方同人游戏领域发展的开始。我们计划在明年内为各位呈上游戏的正篇《东方冰之勇者记 ~ Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy》，继续书写冰之勇者琪露诺的传奇冒险故事。

顺带说明一下，序章与正篇是互相独立的两款游戏，序章的关卡流程不会出现在正篇当中，玩完序章的小伙伴们不用担心在未来的正篇中玩到重复的内容。

如果大家喜欢我们的游戏，并且想要支持游戏的开发，可以通过爱发电平台赞助我们，各位的支持对我们真的非常重要！
[url=https://afdian.net/@TouhouGamePulse]爱发电地址[/url]

最后，真的非常感谢大家一直以来的陪伴与鼓励，我们会继续坚持开发，尽快将游戏的正篇呈现给大家！
